items.title: MECH-074d trainable BLA attribution head vs fixed rule (post-substrate retest; sigma held at 1.0; does NOT supersede 894/894a)
items.note: POST-SUBSTRATE retest of MECH-074d, routed from the confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-894a_2026-08-08 via /implement-substrate. NOT a supersession: V3-EXQ-894 and V3-EXQ-894a stay valid evidence about the non-trainable rule and are what motivated the substrate change; supersedes=None and nothing is de-weighted. WHAT IS ALREADY CLOSED: 894a swept bla_remap_pe_sigma_threshold over [1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5] and REFUTED the over-firing/dilution alternative -- mass-excess falls monotonically with sigma (Spearman -1.0) tracking fire-fraction rather than diverging as dilution predicts, with the per-seed ranking (45 selective / 43 context-blind-deterministic, jaccard gap exactly 0.0 / 42 null) stable at all four thresholds. So sigma is held FIXED at the SD-035 default 1.0 here and the ATTRIBUTION IMPLEMENTATION becomes the arm axis. SUBSTRATE UNDER TEST: ree_core/amygdala/attribution_head.BLAAttributionHead, landed 2026-08-09 (ree-v3 25e04cf5f5 + d2c8d6f2f0) -- the learnable head MECH-074d's own 2026-04-21 registration text deferred as 'a deliberate second pass'. Off by default (bla_attribution_head='contribution_threshold'), so trunk behaviour is bit-identical and only this experiment opts in. ARMS (4x3): ARM_REMAP_OFF (sigma 1e9 drift control / C3 denominator), ARM_HEAD_FIXED (legacy proxy -- a WITHIN-RUN replication of 894a's ARM_SIGMA_10 and the matched control; if it PASSES the attribution half the comparison is void, reported as fixed_unexpectedly_passed), ARM_HEAD_TRAINED (head trained during P0, ~1200 ticks), ARM_HEAD_TRAINED_LONG (+20 gate-shut P1 episodes, ~2400 ticks) -- two budgets so 'the head needs more experience' is TESTED rather than available as an excuse after a null. CRITERIA UNCHANGED from 894/894a (the autopsy judged that instrument unusually careful and already proven informative): C1 attribution_mass_excess > 0.05 AND C2 context_jaccard_gap > 0.05 on >= 2/3 green seeds, with C3 partiality >= 0.5 of the matched control and C4 fire fraction <= 0.25. RUN PASS requires a TRAINABLE arm to pass. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout is C1/C2 under a trainable attribution head, which exists in NO recorded manifest -- the substrate did not exist until 2026-08-09, so every prior run is on an incompatible substrate_hash by construction; a run is required. PRE-CHECK (a 300-tick smoke during the substrate build, NOT evidence -- no precondition gate, no drift control, no pre-registration): legacy -> trainable moved seed 42 mass_excess 0.034 -> 0.115, seed 43 jaccard_gap 0.010 -> 0.059, seed 45 jaccard_gap 0.005 -> 0.227; C2 0/3 -> 2/3 seeds over margin, C1 0/3 -> 1/3, at ~1/20 of this run's training budget. KNOWN INSTRUMENT PRECONDITION: under the legacy ContextMemory write path the slot bank homogenises to off-diagonal cosine 1.0000 within ~24 episodes (V3-EXQ-436c sigmoid-midpoint payload collapse), and no attribution rule can differentiate identical slots -- the per-episode matched-baseline restore inherited from 894a is what keeps C1/C2 measurable, enforced by slot_differentiation_at_window_start and proven by the episode_restore_effective engagement check. NEW ENGAGEMENT CHECKS beyond 894a, all enforced on the full run: trainable_heads_trained_past_warmup (a head still inside its 200-step warmup silently falls back to the LEGACY proxy, which would make the trained arms duplicates of ARM_HEAD_FIXED -- the most likely quiet failure of this design), baseline_store_matched_across_arms (the head's optimiser must not perturb the encoder; its inputs are detached, and this asserts it), attr_mass_excess_varies_across_head_arms (anti-saturation). Self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue if no ON arm has a green cell -- never a substrate verdict. Smoke PASS: --dry-run exercises every code path, all 9 tier-1 engagement checks green, head_n_updates FIXED 0 / TRAINED 36 / LONG 66 confirming the P1 phase adds training and the fixed arm builds no head, and baseline_store_matched_across_arms true confirming the detached-input guarantee. Queued from a headless metaworker chip (chip-20260809-sd035-attribution-head).

items.title: MECH-025: action-doing mode DV redesign (C1 sign reversed per Thura & Cisek 2014 convergence; precision-ratio demoted to non-gating descriptive metric)
items.note: Finishes the routing from the confirmed failure_autopsy_mech025-cluster-876-671b_2026-08-03 (chip-20260808-mech025-doing-mode-dv-redesign; 5+ days unqueued). V3-EXQ-876 was the first fair V3 test of MECH-025 (all 3 prior instrument defects fixed, both regimes well-sampled/non-degenerate in every seed) but its C1 criterion (doing_mode_delta > 0.002) FAILed with the OPPOSITE sign in 4/5 seeds; autopsy classified this measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory because the claim's own cited literature disputes C1's sign convention (Friston 2013: precision is continuous, not a discrete mode switch -- flags C1's whole discrete-split framing as a formal-import mismatch; Thura & Cisek 2014, Neuron, the closer biological reference: PMd/M1 representations CONVERGE, not diverge, during commitment -- predicting a SMALLER causal-signature contrast under commitment, i.e. the negative delta V3-EXQ-876 actually observed). claims.yaml's what_would_answer (2026-08-08 digestion) offered two redesign directions: (1) flip C1's sign per Thura-Cisek, or (2) gate on precision_committed_mean vs precision_uncommitted_mean directly (already recorded in 876, separating 4-5 orders of magnitude every seed, never scored). THIS SCRIPT TAKES (1) AS THE LOAD-BEARING CRITERION AND DEMOTES (2) TO NON-GATING: E3's commit rule is LITERALLY committed=running_variance<threshold, precision=1/variance, so 'committed steps have higher precision' is a near-tautological consequence of the substrate's OWN definition of commitment (ARC-016, already independently stable/validated), not an independently falsifiable prediction of MECH-025 -- gating on it risks a structurally-guaranteed vacuous_pass. Direction (1)'s causal_sig, by contrast, is computed from two genuinely independent E2.world_forward rollouts (actual vs a distinct randomly-sampled counterfactual action) through E3.harm_eval and is not wired to the commit rule's own variance computation at all (DV-symmetry: not a broadcast constant, not a monotone rescale of a shared upstream quantity -- see module docstring for the full declaration). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py --readout precision_committed_mean --claim MECH-025 found exactly ONE compatible manifest (v3_exq_876_..._20260802T214005Z_v3, substrate_hash 5bba8a67...) and its doing_mode_delta values are ALREADY KNOWN to this authoring session (negative in 4/5 seeds) -- reusing/reanalyzing that same data under a reversed-sign criterion would be circular (HARKing) regardless of whether done via a formal reanalysis or a relabeled rerun. NOT reused: this script runs FRESH SEEDS (11,17,29,53,71 -- disjoint from 876's [42,123,7,99,256]; none is 44, the documented reef-config instability seed) through the UNCHANGED, already-validated instrument (same SelectionResult.committed read, same agent.update_residue()-every-tick call, same BreathOscillator config) so the reversed criterion is tested against genuinely new data. C1's magnitude (0.002) is carried over UNCHANGED from 876's own pre-registered bar (only the sign flips) -- not fit to the observed effect sizes (-0.03 to -0.09, ~10-40x larger), leaving real room for the fresh run to fail too. RECORDING FIX: 876's write_flat_manifest(...,config=None,...) gap (flagged in the autopsy) is fixed here (full REEConfig passed via dataclasses.asdict, started_at wired for elapsed_seconds, z_goal_stream_stats via ZGoalStreamAccumulator). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag MECH-025 (the one confirmed autopsy is measurement_test_design_defect, action=none) -- not braked. Substrate readiness (2.5): ARC-016 stable/V3-confirmed (dynamic E3 precision), all 6 depends_on claims unblocked, confirmed via claims.yaml + ree-v3/CLAUDE.md ARC-016 sections. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entries with substrate_paths set at all. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 warnings across every category. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, seed 11, 5/3/30 toy schedule): ran clean, no crash, correct P0-unready self-route at toy scale (expected, not load-bearing), progress lines (ep N/M) + verdict line + precision_ratio all emit correctly. Landed via a throwaway worktree at origin/main (shared ree-v3 checkout dirty with other sessions' live WIP + concurrent phase3-queue snapshot writers -- first rebase attempt hit a merge conflict against an intervening snapshot commit, resolved by re-forking a fresh worktree off the newer origin/main tip rather than hand-resolving JSON conflict markers). Step 8.6 (POST /queue/add) to be performed immediately after this push from this same box (coordinator.env present).

items.title: ARC-032 theta-bypass DIRECT readout: z_goal persistence + goal-proximity-score noise at E3-tick granularity (redesign of 228b)
items.note: Redesign of V3-EXQ-228b per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-228b_2026-08-09. 228b was the FIRST run in the 076/228/247/228a/228b lineage to clear ARC-032's non-degeneracy precondition (goal_norm 1.00 frac seeds), theta-patch confirmed non-inert, but its resource-lift readout FAILED with two measurement-adequacy defects the autopsy would not accept as falsifying: (a) E3-tick cache-gating dilutes any theta-specific signal ~9x in a full-episode aggregate; (b) the driver measured a downstream behavioral proxy, never claims.yaml's own CONFIRMING DVs (z_goal persistence, goal-proximity-score noise). 228c keeps 228b's proven shared-training/deepcopy-split THETA_ACTIVE-vs-THETA_ZEROED architecture BYTE-IDENTICAL and changes ONLY the measurement: scores z_goal persistence (lag-1 cosine of z_goal) and goal-proximity-score noise (temporal std of the lead candidate's goal_proximity) DIRECTLY, restricted to E3-tick steps where the ablation acts. Behavioral resource-lift kept informational. GOV-REUSE-1: the E3-tick-restricted persistence/noise readouts are NOT recorded in 228b's manifest (which recorded only full-episode resource_visit_rate/harm_rate/zgoal_norm_mean) and are not derivable by reanalysis -> genuine new run. Re-derive brake: does NOT fire (ARC-032 counted-ceiling count=1 < 2; and this is a measurement_test_design_defect redesign, action:none, not a substrate-ceiling power-bump). DV-symmetry: both DVs are genuinely sensitive to zeroing theta (not arithmetic invariants) -- persistence via the behavioral->benefit->z_goal loop, proximity-noise via the proposer's z_world_for_e3 input (smoke confirms C2 differs between arms: 0.0216 vs 0.0342). Reversed direction (theta ACTIVE worse) is registered as a finding (converges with MECH-089 EXQ-066/EXQ-122 that static theta-averaging harms E3 discrimination), NOT dismissed. Runs under known substrate_queue defect SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (severity: degrading, e3_selector.py). Prefer cloud (228b ran on ree-worker-3, ~221 min).
